//: A torch packed with firesalt: burns twice as long as a plain torch (40 charges, one a minute) and a little brighter.
description: A stick wrapped in rags with crushed firesalt worked into the cloth.  It burns hotter and much longer than a torch soaked in fuel.  Use it to light it.

use_action.msg: The firesalt catches with a crackle and a red glow.

//: Lit firesalt torch: 40 minutes of light (light 70 against a torch's 60); burns down to a plain burnt-out torch.
description: A torch packed with firesalt, burning with a steady red-orange flame.  It throws more light than a fuel torch and lasts far longer.

use_action.msg: You smother the torch.  The salt keeps glowing for a moment.

//: A quick fire-starter: a paper twist of crushed firesalt, five uses. FIRESTARTER, so NPCs who light fires can use it too.
description: A twist of paper holding a pinch of crushed firesalt.  Rub it between your fingers over some tinder and it flares up on its own, wet weather or not.  Good for about five fires.

//: Like the fuel torch, but firesalt instead of a flammable liquid.
